_comment: A 3DS project is one decrypted game, and whatever it already saved.

slots.title: Game
slots.help: A DECRYPTED dump: a cartridge (.3ds/.cci), an executable content (.cxi/.app), or homebrew (.3dsx/.elf). Azahar does not decrypt; an encrypted dump is a load error that says so. An old dump whose header still says 'encrypted' after it was decrypted is recognised and runs.

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: What the game already saved, as Emulator > Export Save Data... wrote it: a .zip of the SD card's Nintendo 3DS folder (the game's save archive and extra data). It goes back onto the machine's SD card before the game starts.
